_comment: BPSC TRE CS format: 150 questions, 2 hours 30 min. Add your actual questions below.
instructions: 150 questions | 2.5 hours | 1 mark each | No negative marking

questions.question: Which generation of computers used transistors?
questions.explanation: Second Generation computers (1956-1963) में vacuum tubes की जगह transistors use हुए। ये smaller, faster और more reliable थे।

questions.question: What is the binary equivalent of decimal number 10?
questions.explanation: 10 decimal को binary में convert करें: 10÷2=5 R0, 5÷2=2 R1, 2÷2=1 R0, 1÷2=0 R1। Bottom to top: 1010।
